name: Drive X 🏎️ CARS
desc:
Welcome to DRIVE X.  Open-world car driving & racing game on Roblox! 🚗💨

Drive, cruise, race, drift, and explore a massive city. Choose from 170+ cars including sports cars, supercars, hypercars, SUVs, and off-road vehicles. Drive your way and build your collection.

🏁 Race anyone, anywhere
🚘 Drive freely in an open world
🏆 Leaderboards for miles, wins & cash

UPDATE❗
4 New Cars buy in shop or dealership
1v1 Races rewards increased
2 New Races

New Features
🚗 Trafic
🔧Car Modifications 

🔥 If you love car games, driving games, and racing, DRIVE X is for you.
Start driving. Start racing. Rule the streets.
👍⭐ Thumbs up if you like the game and want new cars and updates
